summary.name: MakeImg
summary.one_liner: MakeImg is an AI photo generator that turns a text prompt or a reference photo into a new image, with a choice of models and aspect ratios.
use_cases: Creating product photos with a chosen setting and lighting
Generating images from a text prompt
Turning a reference photo into a new picture
Making square or other aspect-ratio images
Iterating on images in the same workspace
summary.what_it_does: The page describes generating images from a text prompt or from an uploaded reference photo. Users pick a model, set the aspect ratio, and generate images in seconds, then keep editing in the same workspace. For product images, it offers to create a photo with a setting and light suited to the item, and suggests GPT Image 2.5 as one option. A reference upload can be used when the real product must guide the result. The page's example prompt is a blue glass perfume bottle beside an orange, shown as a square composition. The page advises comparing shape, label and finish with the actual product before publishing.
notable: Choice of multiple models, including GPT Image 2.5, with 11 models per the directory listing
Can start from a text prompt or a reference photo
Free daily credits per the directory listing
caveats: Generated product images may not match a real product's shape, label or finish, so checking against the actual item is advised
